notes.title: Demo Incoming: Black Paradox Reloaded Lands on December 3rd!
notes.content:
Hello, bounty hunters! 🚀

Over the past few months, we got a bit sidetracked trying to find a publisher to help us with the game's marketing. After several attempts (and quite a bit of time wasted), we decided to move forward on our own and refocus not only on development but also on communicating directly with you about the game.

[h3][b]The demo is almost ready and will be available on December 3rd![/b][/h3] It includes the first two levels of the game and will let you try out all the different weapons, upgrades, and power-ups that will be featured in the full version.

[previewyoutube=DBSvWDSLIhA;full][/previewyoutube]

In the demo, you'll also find an option to leave your feedback. Please do so! Your input is incredibly valuable to help us ensure we're heading in the right direction and to adjust things based on what you want to see.

If you can’t wait until December 3rd, you can sign up for our mailing list to join a beta testing phase for the demo: subscribepage.io/GEtgKa


As for the full game, we’ve finished the reskin and are now focused on improving game balance and polishing the remaining boss fights.

We’re aiming to release the full game in early 2025.

That’s all for now.

Catch you next time!

notes.title: Progress Update & Beta Testing Sign-Up
notes.content:
Hello Bounty Hunters,

We aim to keep you updated on our progress by posting a devlog every two weeks.

Development is going smoothly, and we are on track to complete the project by October.

We are wrapping up the development of the first two game levels, which will be included in a demo for the beta testing session. This demo will also feature the garage section, where you can enhance your vehicle's stats by purchasing chips that modify your machine.
Various in-game power-ups will be available, including drones, special abilities, and different types of weapons.

We hope you enjoy it and look forward to your feedback. 
[h2][url=https://subscribepage.io/GEtgKa]Sign up for beta testing here![/url] [/h2]

We are putting significant effort into the new game graphics. Here you can see a comparison between some elements of the original game and the reloaded version.
